title: $20 an hour to $1 million: why the math never works
audience: United States only: US dollars, US federal tax (IRS 2026 brackets + FICA), BLS inflation, US spelling, American settings
chunks: Feels like a rigged game, right?
You were just taught half the rules.

cast.Blob: brand character: white round face, short black hair, teal shirt #1FA6A0, thin black line limbs; athlete headband (red) only in the yoga shots
cast.Tax man (boss role): navy suit #24324F, red tie, grey short hair, holds a clipboard - takes the tax cut from the jar
cast.Yoga student / crowd (friend role): bright casual shirts, varied hair; one student live, then a crowd of small viewers on mats

places.money stage: a bright American game-show-like studio: cream tile floor, navy back wall panels with gold trim, a treadmill under a giant wall clock on the left, a huge glass money jar in the middle, a giant 3D bar chart on the right (gold bars), green dollar bills and gold coins with a $ mark
places.yoga studio: warm wood plank floor, sage-green walls, big window with afternoon sun, potted plants, rolled mats; a camera on a tripod; then thousands of tiny viewers on mats stretching away

beats.million: push to the huge empty jar - one $20 bill flutters in and lies alone at the bottom
beats.twentyfour: the first gold bar shoots up, card 24 YEARS counts up
beats.full: the time clock punches a card, the wall-clock hands blur through 40 hours
beats.cent: Blob turns his empty pockets out, every coin goes in the jar
beats.taxes: the tax man scoops a chunk of coins out of the jar with a clipboard; source card (IRS 2026 brackets + FICA)
beats.twentyeight: bar 2 rises above bar 1, card 28 YEARS
beats.rent: a 3D pie chart flips in: a big 80% slice (rent, food) slides away, a thin 20% slice stays
beats.forty: bar 3 rockets up through the top of the frame, crane up, card 140 YEARS, Blob jaw drop
beats.double: a price tag on a grocery bag flips from $5 to $10 while the coin pile in the jar shrinks to half; source card (BLS CPI, about 3% a year)
beats.rigged: grey mood; the treadmill speeds up, Blob sweats and slides backward
beats.isnt: flash: the treadmill stops dead, colour floods back, Blob blinks
beats.wrong: equation card MONEY = HOURS x RATE slams in, a red X stamps on it
beats.ceiling: two bars (a clock bar and a dollar bar) rise and bonk into a glass ceiling slab that drops on them
beats.problems: equation card MONEY = PROBLEMS SOLVED x PEOPLE REACHED; a lightbulb lights, little people multiply
beats.noceiling: the glass ceiling shatters, the bar shoots through, Blob cheers
beats.yoga: WHY shot, left: Blob (red headband) teaches one student live; $100/HR card; a clock above him ticks one coin per hour
beats.film: camera on a tripod blinks red; whip to the right half
beats.thousands: right: a crowd of tiny viewers on mats stretches away along a diagonal, coins rain into a jar that overflows
beats.game: finale aerial on a diagonal: near = the treadmill lane with one small jar, far = the studio with an overflowing pile; golden light
beats.half: slam to Blob, smug, pointing at the second half of the equation card lighting up
beats.subscribe: CTA over the golden shot; the light ramps back to the bright frame-0 look and the shot returns to the treadmill frame 0 (loop)

frame0: Blob mid-sprint on a treadmill under a giant wall clock whose hands race; gold coins plink into the jar one by one; the 24-year gold bar already rising behind
